query: OOM on 3090/V100 with LTX 2.3 after a KJNodes update; OP rolled back to commit 8ba02bd as workaround.

desired.outcome: Maintainer kijai (2026-03-19): the memory-relevant nodes were disabled in the posted workflow and 'it has nothing to do with KJNodes if you have them disabled'; suggested enabling the chunk feedforward node to reduce VRAM. OP's rollback not validated as the true cause.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
desired.answer_guidance: Maintainer kijai (2026-03-19): the memory-relevant nodes were disabled in the posted workflow and 'it has nothing to do with KJNodes if you have them disabled'; suggested enabling the chunk feedforward node to reduce VRAM. OP's rollback not validated as the true cause.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.
